summary: Northlight Growth sells website builds, Google Ads management and local SEO to clinics. Five Maps searches across Dubai returned 58 dental clinics. Each of these ten shows something on its own Google listing or website that sits inside what Northlight already delivers, and each line below can be checked in a few seconds by opening the link beside it. This is an illustrative pack: the agency and every business are fictional.

fit.no_site: With {reviews} reviews and no website on the listing, there is no page of its own to rank or to send ad traffic to. A first site is Northlight's entry project.
fit.dead_site: The listing sends people to a link that does not open. Every tap on Website is a lost visit until the site is rebuilt or the link is fixed.
fit.not_https: Browsers mark the site Not secure before a patient reads a word. Moving it to https is a small first job that opens the door to the rest.
fit.stale: A footer that still says {year} suggests nobody has touched the site since, which is the redesign conversation.
fit.no_ads_tags: No Google tag or Meta Pixel means no paid search or paid social is being measured here, so a Google Ads account would start clean.
fit.low_reviews: {reviews} reviews against a median of {median} in the same searches: a local SEO and review-request job.
fit.low_rating: A {rating} rating, where the median in the same searches is {median}, is the first thing a new patient sees. That is where local SEO work has to start.

method: Illustrative pack: every business is fictional, so nothing was searched or opened. A real pack states here the date of its Maps searches and the date each listing and website was opened in a browser, and what was checked.
